# Rose Dental Nashua

> Rose Dental Nashua is a cosmetic and implant dentistry practice in Nashua, NH offering comprehensive dental services with state-of-the-art CEREC technology.

Rose Dental Nashua is led by prosthodontist Dr. Min Zhu and features a team of Boston University-educated dentists including Dr. Kevin Hsu, Dr. Jade Li, and Dr. Wen-Tse Lin. The practice specializes in cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, restorative procedures, and preventive care for patients throughout the Greater Boston Area and New Hampshire.

## Core Services

- [Dental Services Overview](https://rosedentalnashua.com/dental-services): Rose Dental services overview: cosmetic, restorative, implants, emergency care & whitening.
- [Dental Implants](https://rosedentalnashua.com/dental-services/dental-implant-dentists): Dental implant specialty: titanium implants with porcelain crowns for tooth replacement.
- [Root Canal Therapy](https://rosedentalnashua.com/dental-services/root-canal-therapy): Root canal therapy to save natural teeth & prevent need for implants or bridges.
- [Comprehensive Dental Checkups](https://rosedentalnashua.com/dental-services/comprehensive-dental-checkup-services): Comprehensive checkup services: preventive care, early detection & personalized consultations.
- [Dental Crowns](https://rosedentalnashua.com/dental-services/crowns): Porcelain crowns & crown restoration using CEREC technology for natural appearance.
- [Teeth Fillings](https://rosedentalnashua.com/dental-services/fillings): Tooth-colored fillings & restorations: CEREC technology, porcelain inlays & silver replacement.
- [Dental Bridges](https://rosedentalnashua.com/dental-services/bridges): Dental bridges for missing teeth: fixed & removable options for tooth replacement.
- [Tooth Extractions](https://rosedentalnashua.com/dental-services/extractions): Tooth extraction procedures with aftercare instructions & pain management guidance.

## Preventive & Additional Services

- [Dental Sealants](https://rosedentalnashua.com/dental-services/sealants): Dental sealants for decay prevention on chewing surfaces, especially for children.
- [Denture Services](https://rosedentalnashua.com/dental-services/dentures): Denture replacement & relining services to maintain jaw alignment & fit.
